items.name: Record backlog and strong order rates, Q3 2026
items.claim: Caterpillar's chairman and CEO said third-quarter results reflect strong order rates and a record backlog, per its third-quarter earnings release (no dollar backlog figure disclosed).
items.source_excerpt: Our third-quarter results reflect the durability of our end markets, with strong order rates and a record backlog,

notes: Q3 2026 8-K earnings release (accession 0000018230-26-000052, filed 2026-10-29) is the only stored evidence for Caterpillar. It confirms a qualitative record backlog and strong order rates at company level but discloses no segment-level or dollar backlog figure; the earlier Q2 segment-by-segment backlog sentence is no longer in the stored document.
